# Android Asset Setup - Version Control Guide

Add these patterns to your `.gitignore` to exclude generated Android assets:

```gitignore
# ============================================================
# Android Generated Assets (auto-generated, don't commit)
# ============================================================

# Launcher icons (all densities)
android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/ic_launcher*.png
android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/

# Splash screens (portrait variants)
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-port-*/splash.png
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-port-*/splash_.*
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-port-night-*/splash.png

# Splash screens (landscape variants)
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-land-*/splash.png
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-land-*/splash_.*
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-land-night-*/splash.png

# Base splash screens
android/app/src/main/res/drawable/splash.png
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-night/splash.png

# ============================================================
# Android Build Output
# ============================================================

android/app/build/
android/build/
android/.gradle/
*.apk
*.aab

# ============================================================
# IDE and Environment
# ============================================================

.gradle/
.idea/
*.iml
*.iws
*.ipr

# ============================================================
# OS Files
# ============================================================

.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# ============================================================
# Environment Files
# ============================================================

.env
.env.local
.env.*.local
```

## Committing Source Images

✅ **DO commit these to version control:**

```gitignore
resources/icon.png      # Keep original icon
resources/splash.png    # Keep original splash
resources/README.md     # This documentation
```

Or keep source files separate:

```
/design/
  /source/
    icon.psd            # Photoshop/Figma source
    splash.psd
  /exported/
    icon.png            # Exported for Capacitor
    splash.png
```

## Managing Generated Assets

Generated files are in:

- `android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/`
- `android/app/src/main/res/drawable-port-*/`
- `android/app/src/main/res/drawable-land-*/`

These are automatically regenerated by running `npm run assets:generate`, so no need to track them in git.

## Sharing Project with Team

When pushing to git:

1. **Commit:**

   - `.gitignore` with patterns above
   - `resources/icon.png` and `resources/splash.png`
   - `scripts/` helper scripts
   - `package.json` with all npm scripts

2. **Don't commit:**

   - Generated Android assets in `res/`
   - Build artifacts in `android/app/build/`
   - `.gradle/` and `.idea/` directories

3. **After cloning:**
   - Run: `npm install`
   - Run: `npm run assets:generate`
   - Run: `npm run cap:sync`
   - Open: `npx cap open android`

## Recommended .gitignore Update

Run this command to apply the recommended patterns:

```bash
cat >> .gitignore << 'EOF'

# Android Generated Assets
android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/ic_launcher*.png
android/app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-port-*/splash.png
android/app/src/main/res/drawable-land-*/splash.png
android/app/src/main/res/drawable*/splash.png

# Android Build
android/app/build/
android/build/
android/.gradle/
*.apk
*.aab

# IDE
.gradle/
.idea/
*.iml

# OS
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
EOF
```

Then verify with:

```bash
git status
```
